Token và dữ liệu nằm ở đâu?: Where are tokens and data stored?
Token OAuth, cấu hình kết nối và cache l: OAuth tokens, connection settings and cache are stored locally in your Windows user's EasyMount data folder. Cloud connections and transfers run directly between your computer and the provider through rclone. Cached files may include content copies; protect access to your Windows account and drives.
Website cung cấp hướng dẫn, danh sách dị: The website provides guides, supported providers, release information and write-priority examples. The simulation API processes only example names, source capacities and file sizes, without storing simulation data in a database. Do not enter account information or sensitive paths into examples.
Backend không nhận token cloud, mật khẩu: The backend does not receive cloud tokens, passwords or app file content. The releases API may retrieve public metadata from GitHub; installed versions are compared locally. The website does not install its own advertising or analytics tools. Hosting infrastructure may process technical access logs, including IP addresses and request information, to operate the service.
Bạn chọn tài khoản, thư mục, quyền đọc/g: You choose accounts, folders, read/write access and when to disconnect. You can revoke EasyMount access in your provider's security settings. Removing an account from the app does not delete cloud data. Uninstalling preserves settings and cache to protect pending uploads. Delete cache only after verifying all uploads are complete.
Việc sử dụng và chuyển dữ liệu nhận từ G: Use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including Limited Use requirements. EasyMount does not use cloud data for advertising or AI model training.
